## About

Zhihao recently joined Temporal as a Staff Software Engineer on Infrastructure Foundations. Before that he spent 3.5+ years at Duolingo as a Senior/Staff Software Engineer on the Cloud Operations team, building infrastructure and platforms that made engineers more effective.

At Duolingo he championed Temporal adoption from 0→1, scaling it into an org-wide durable workflow platform powering 230+ production workflows across 20+ teams and 17M+ Temporal Cloud actions/month. He received the Duolingo Innovation Award for building the Temporal platform, presented by CEO and co-founder Luis von Ahn.

Earlier: Senior Backend Engineer and Scrum Master at data.ai (formerly App Annie), and Software Engineer at VIPKID.

## Work experience (summary)

### Temporal Technologies — Pittsburgh, PA
- Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure Foundations (Sep 2026 – present)

### Duolingo — Pittsburgh, PA
- Staff Software Engineer, Cloud Operations (Apr 2026 – Sep 2026)
  - Technical lead for a Temporal infrastructure project team; ECS→EKS Temporal worker migration with KEDA autoscaling; multi-account AWS datastore/service migrations
  - Duolingo Innovation Award for the Temporal platform
- Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Operations (Feb 2023 – Mar 2026)
  - 0→1 Temporal adoption; Temporal Self-Service Platform; developer experience in the Temporal monorepo; datastore DR via Temporal workflows; de facto DBRE ownership for Aurora PostgreSQL

### data.ai (formerly App Annie) — Beijing, China
- Senior Backend Software Engineer & Scrum Master (Feb 2018 – Jul 2021)
  - Unified connection workflows / MFA migrations; Django→Flask/Go microservices; scraping framework; Scrum Master for 6+

### VIPKID — Beijing, China
- Software Engineer & Intern (Aug 2016 – Feb 2018)
  - Flask/gRPC/Java/Spring Boot microservices; Celery async tasks
